property_summary: After minting a game item, the reference contract returns true for supportsInterface(IERC1155.interfaceId) and IERC1155MetadataURI.interfaceId, while the mutant returns true only for those two and false for IERC165.interfaceId.
change_summary: Swap the order of the IERC1155 and IERC1155MetadataURI checks (no semantic change, but combined with other edits could matter). However, this edit alone is equivalent, so I omit it. I keep only high-confidence non-equivalent mutants. Actually, swapping equivalent for bytes4 bitwise comparison is equivalent, so not included. Only include edits that truly change return value for some input. For example, removing the super.supportsInterface call changes support for IERC165 itself. So: delete super.supportsInterface call.
